settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage appearance, controls, local storage, and backups.

recoveryCenter.title: Recovery Center
recoveryCenter.description: Backup files are read only on this device and are not uploaded. You can verify and preview every import before it changes data.
recoveryCenter.exportDesc: Includes workspaces, flat tab lists, tab groups, timeline, notes, linked resources, and portable settings without site icons, plus a SHA-256 integrity check.
recoveryCenter.exportWarnings: {{count}} items could not be safely included. Nothing was downloaded yet; review the omissions first.
recoveryCenter.importDesc: Supports current v3 files and remains compatible with legacy v1/v2 files. Reading a file does not change your data.
recoveryCenter.integrityVerified: SHA-256 checksum matches · source not verified

merge.title: Safe merge (recommended)
merge.desc: Keep current data and remap conflicting IDs and names.

replace.title: Full replacement
replace.desc: Replace workspaces from the file and clear runtime window bindings, pending actions, and Agent sessions.

recoveryCenter.includeSettingsHint: Includes language, theme, accent, and sorting. Agent control and developer switches are never imported.
recoveryCenter.replaceConfirm: I understand this replaces current workspace data. TabPlex will roll back automatically if the transaction fails.
recoveryCenter.currentUnavailable: Current data exceeds the safe preview range. You can still use Replace all for a rescue restore.
recoveryCenter.mergeUnavailable: Current data could not be read completely, so a safe merge is unavailable.
recoveryCenter.moreWarnings: {{count}} more notices are collapsed to protect interface performance.

warningCodes.legacy-window-slots-flattened: Legacy multi-window layouts were merged into flat tab lists in their saved order
warningCodes.legacy-v1-unverified: Legacy file has no integrity checksum
warningCodes.legacy-v1-missing-contexts: Legacy file has no notes or linked resources
warningCodes.invalid-tab-dropped: Invalid or unsafe tab was ignored
warningCodes.orphan-context-dropped: Context without a workspace was ignored

errors.generic: This backup could not be processed. Existing data was not replaced; check the file and try again.
errors.note-save-failed: A note is still unsaved, so export or restore was stopped.
errors.settings-save-failed: A setting is still unsaved, so export or import was stopped.
errors.backup-too-large: The file exceeds the 8 MiB safety limit.
errors.backup-string-budget-exceeded: Text content in the backup exceeds the 6 MiB safety limit.
errors.backup-current-unavailable: Current data could not be read completely. Choose Replace all for a rescue restore.
errors.invalid-json: The file is not valid JSON.
errors.invalid-schema: This is not a TabPlex backup file.
errors.unsupported-version: This backup version is not supported.
errors.unsupported-integrity: The file uses an unsupported integrity format.
errors.checksum-mismatch: SHA-256 verification failed. The file may be damaged or modified.
errors.quotaLocal: There is not enough local storage space; nothing was restored.
errors.quotaSync: There is not enough browser-sync space; nothing was restored.
errors.backup-restore-recovered-previous-transa: The previous interrupted restore was handled first. Review and confirm this import again.
errors.backup-restore-journal-invalid: The recovery journal could not be read safely, so the operation stopped.
errors.backup-restore-failed: Restore failed. Existing data was preserved or rolled back.

aiNaming.title: AI Naming
aiNaming.description: The local model is prepared on first use
aiNaming.backgroundHint: You can close Settings. Chrome will continue preparing in the background.
aiNaming.sizeNote: Chrome manages download, updates, and cleanup itself. The extension only gets stage information and percentage progress, not total bytes or downloaded bytes.

agentControl.title: Agent control
agentControl.desc: Allow local Agents to use a Skill to manage workspaces, tabs, and settings, with TabPlex validating each write before it is applied.
agentControl.permissionDenied: Chrome did not grant local app communication. Agent control remains off.
agentControl.permissionRemovalFailed: Agent control is off, but Chrome could not remove its local app communication permission.

onboarding.title: Onboarding
onboarding.hint: Re-run will create a new guide workspace for debugging.
onboarding.triggered: Onboarding will re-run. Close settings to view.

logs.title: Verbose logs
logs.desc: Also print logs to the console for debugging.

about.desc: Group tabs into workspaces and switch contexts safely to keep research and work focused.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.desc: TabPlex is an open-source project we maintain together. Report issues, share ideas, or contribute code; attach logs to bug reports to make diagnosis easier.
feedback.mailHint: Logs copied. Paste them into the email.

backup.title: Local backup
backup.desc: Export or import workspaces, tabs, timeline, notes, and portable settings. Files stay on this device.
backup.importConfirm: Importing replaces current workspaces and portable settings from this file and disconnects existing Agent sessions. TabPlex rolls back automatically on failure. Continue?

backup.restored: Restored {{count}} workspaces from a local backup.
backup.restoredCleanupPending: Restored {{count}} workspaces. The local recovery journal is waiting for automatic cleanup.

guideWorkspace.name: Quick Start
guideWorkspace.note:
Quick start checklist
1. Hover a workspace on the left to preview, click to switch
2. Click the + button to create a workspace
3. Drag browser tabs into a workspace
4. Write notes on the right to capture context
